name: EPIC 211403194
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 10.7 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,477 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.93 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,766 K at its surface.
